info.title: Ascentic.SkillKit
info.description: A generic dotnet tool that installs AI skills and agents into your projects. Supports Clean Architecture, Vertical Slice, and Modular Monolith patterns with 26+ skills and 5 agents. Works with any AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Ascentic SkillKit — installs AI skills & agents into your projects
